title: Not showing ongoing events
body:
Few years ago i was “forced” to move to Google Calendar due to useless monthly view with the dots in iCal. When I’ve seen that Apple fixed it with the latest update and added new views, I went straight back to install this one again.

After using it for a while I’ve noticed one thing that’s driving me insane - the widgets on iPhone and Apple Watch as well never show ongoing events (as I was used to in Google Calendar) and is showing me that I have no events today.

Once the event starts, it automatically dissapears from all devices and I have to manually go to the app to check my day. Sometimes when I have like 6-8 events going on it’s easy to get lost and then the app becomes useless.

Pleeease fix this. 🫠
